title: We Walk Around With Old Hurt Inside Of Us - There Is A Way To Release It
text: we walk around with old hurt inside of us from many many years ago in our lives from betrayal broken trust not being validated not being heard being misunderstood being hurt by people that we love people we don't love relationships relationship breakups work relationships because what we do is we Harbor toxic baggage from wounds that have been sitting inside of us for a very long time inside of our soul side of our heart inside of our spirit I'm very happy to announce you can sign up to the collecting Stones meditation Journey that is going to be so profound and so powerful it's going to blow your mind it's going to move you forward you're not going to experience anything like this it's a seven day Journey I'm going to guide you personally through stones have an ability to absorb but that ability is not tapped into when you start that Journey on the 19th something incredible happens and a deeper connection starts to occur when you do the collecting Stones meditation Journey you're going to be getting stones that are out in the wild collect your stones on the day it starts have an idea of where you're going to collect your Stones maybe it's going to be some grassy knoll somewhere maybe it's going to be some field maybe it's going to be some trail maybe it's going to be a park maybe it's going to be a beach wherever it is those stones are going to be meant for you for this reason for this profound way to absorb and draw something out of you that shouldn't be there anymore sign up and start to think about where you're going to get your stones this is the summer of healing this is a summer of healing emotionally mentally spiritually when you're doing this journey you're gonna feel it a deep connection is going to grow an unbelievably deep connection that's how profound and that's how incredible this journey is going to be [Music]
